description: a box over [0, 10] × [0, 6] whose top is a bicubic B-spline (5 × 5 poles, two spans each way, heights 3 to 4.2), its boundary poles in the four wall planes, written by tools/oracle/occt_nurbs_blend.py: the top edge on the wall y = 0, the B-spline isocurve v = 0, filleted at r 0.5. A NURBS face against a plane has no closed form, so the blend is a walked stripe (ADR-0062): the ball's centre on the section of the top's fitted offset and the wall's exact one, the surface fitted through its arcs, each end cut by the wall across, x = 0 and x = 10, both planes (plans/nurbs-face-blend step 5b). Arris' blend holds the ball at r from both faces to 8e-9 at 451 samples over the face; Open CASCADE's misses it by 2.1e-5 at the median and 1.1e-4 at the 90th percentile, at its default approximation and at 1e-8 alike, so its volume lies 9.8e-5 (4.8e-7 relative) and its area 2.6e-4 (1.2e-6) above Arris'. The measure tolerances cover that miss, under ADR-0062's 1e-5 for a walked fixture (no closed form holds the blend)
